newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - December 20.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - December 20.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Friday. Reuter has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Tycoon Oung Ta-ming sentenced to four years in prison for stock manipulation.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Tax exemption ceiling for pensions set at T$150,000 per year.
Foreign Minister John Chang has lunch with Jordan's King Hussein.
LIBERTY TIMES - President Lee Teng-hui agrees to study possibility of halting provincial elections.
Police release telephone confession of man claiming he was killer of Taoyuan county magistrate and seven others.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Taiwan's top economic policymaker Chiang Pin-kung to make proposal for central America investments to President Lee Teng-hui.
Oil prices to be adjusted next week at earliest.
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Investment ceiling for individual foreign funds to invest in stocks relaxed to US$600 million.
Motherboard maker Asustek to allocate T$350 million for employees' year-end bonuses.
